warning: Descriptive annual trend only. Not a fish-kill prediction, not a 72-hour model, and not an advisory.

stationNames: Stn V - West Bay near Pasig River

method: Ordinary least squares with station fixed effects and a common linear year term; HC3 standard errors; 1,000-replicate cluster bootstrap by station.
caveat: The estimates describe annual station summaries. They do not use observation dates, do not establish causation, and do not predict fish kills.

reasons: Water quality is reported as annual station summaries, not dated observations.
Rainfall and wind are monthly station summaries, not daily or sub-daily series.
There are zero pre-event observations and zero usable 24-hour labels.
There is one reported event and no verified negative windows.
Station coordinates and an authoritative lake-zone crosswalk are absent.

notes: The model is fitted only to the nine stations with a complete 2016-2025 DO record.
The fish-kill risk state remains unavailable and is not derived from this model.
The synthetic 72-hour experiments remain separate and are not evidence.
